value: large eye, cornea globular and well pigmented
method: taxonomic description of preserved type specimens
conditions: Adult male holotype (BL 2.52 mm, UKMMZ-1623; figure captions cite UKMMZ-1632), Turtle Tomb cave, Sipadan Island, Sabah, Malaysia, 9 September 2025, 22 m depth by SCUBA.
